home_booth.note: Command Center — hero, crew status, latest proof, active mission, ledger. LIVE/DEMO labels truthful.

workspaces.note: Project grid — live engine card, demo cards, local CONCEPT scaffolds, project detail modal, New Workspace create flow.

mission_control.note: Dispatch Lane (code tasks + unreal missions), live lane from /api/code/tasks + workboard + unreal-coder missions, demo lane, full inspector (phases, steps, evidence, verdicts, cancel/validate/resume/retry).

agent_room.note: Crew station view with per-worker states, foreman bar, worker dossier modals, live holo terminal readout.

proof_vault.note: LIVE/DEMO proof viewer, prev/next + fullscreen + approve/request-change, freshness chip, gallery, reveal animation.

quests.note: Durable local quest store, steps tick from real events only, truthful ≥8.5 live-proof step.

finance.note: LOCAL ledger vs DEMO seed separation, billing explicitly FUTURE.

settings.note: Engine base URL, name, preferences, truthful ClickUp BLOCKED contract, live integration rows.

owned_paths.ui/aivido.html: SPA shell: mobile bottom nav, More sheet, overlays, templates
owned_paths.ui/aivido.css: all styling + Phase 3 final pass (mobile nav, focus, motion, reduced-motion)
owned_paths.scripts/ui_health_check.py: element-reference integrity check (JS ids vs HTML ids)
owned_paths.scripts/aivido_dev_server.py: dev-only server proxying /api to the live backend (pre-existing, untouched by this pass)

responsive.method: iframe audit harness (ui/responsive-test.html) — each width loads the real booth with fast boot and checks: desktop rail ↔ mobile bottom-nav swap, no horizontal page trap (scrollWidth <= clientWidth on every screen + stage wrap), at least one screen active.
responsive.mobile_nav: bottom nav at <=768px (6 items: Booth/Worlds/Mission/Room/Proof/More); More opens a 2x2 sheet with Quests/Finance/Profile/Settings
responsive.desktop_rail: icon rail <=1100px, full rail above; unchanged behavior preserved

items: cinematic sting + letterbox screen transitions (pre-existing, preserved)
progress bars sweep on width change
dispatch success pulse on the Dispatch Lane
reduced-motion media query kills all animation/transition for users who ask
motion.principle: fast and restrained — no long or looping UI animation added beyond subtle states

reliability.no_js_runtime_exceptions: verified — zero console errors across boot, navigation, modals, proof, and audit harness (8 live iframe instances)
reliability.request_timeout: api() wrapped in AbortController, 8s default (20s for frame-and-proof)
reliability.bounded_retries: mission polling is single-chain and self-terminates on terminal states or missing mission
reliability.safe_localStorage_recovery: corrupt/unreadable store falls back to fresh defaults (was a boot-crash risk)
reliability.stale_async_response_protection: monotonic _proofReq token — only the newest capture/refresh may render
reliability.duplicate_click_idempotency: dispatch lane busy-guard disables the button; capture guarded against overlap
reliability.truthful_labels: LIVE / DEMO / CONCEPT / BLOCKED / FUTURE / LOCAL distinctions verified in the live session (LIVE frame badge, LIVE mission lane, DEMO lane, CONCEPT workspace cards, ClickUp BLOCKED)

keyboard_focus.tab_trap: focus cycles inside open modals and returns to the trigger on close
keyboard_focus.arrows: left/right walk the proof vault (pre-existing, preserved)
keyboard_focus.focus_visible: explicit brass outline on all interactive elements
keyboard_focus.auto_focus: workspace-name field focused on create-modal open

validation.ui_health_check: PASS — every JS element reference resolves to an HTML id (scripts/ui_health_check.py)
validation.live_backend: UI validated against the LIVE backend (127.0.0.1:8765 via dev-server proxy): engine linked, LIVE mode, live task lane rendered real tasks, LIVE proof frame loaded

known_blockers: ClickUp sync stays BLOCKED — no credentials or gateway tool in this environment (truthful, by design; contract documented in Settings)
Workspace scaffolding is a local Booth entry (CONCEPT) — the engine lane owns real project creation
Proof verdict for engine frames may read '—' until the pipeline's visual gate reports a verdict (rendered verbatim, never synthesized)

integration_instructions_worker5.serve: dev: python scripts/aivido_dev_server.py 8866 (serves ui/ + proxies /api to the backend); product: additive GET /app route already registered in app/api.py, static via /static
integration_instructions_worker5.no_backend_changes_required: UI is read-only over the canonical backend; dispatch uses the exact endpoints the ClickUp gateway uses
integration_instructions_worker5.local_stores: aivido_phase1_v1 (settings/state), aivido_quests_v1 (quest ticks), aivido_ledger_v1 (ledger rows), aivido_workspaces_v1 (local concept scaffolds) — all versioned, all guarded against corruption
